meta.verification_note: These answers describe what the Farmo app itself does. They are VERIFIED against the Farmo product, not third-party claims.

faq.question: What does Farmo do?
faq.answer: Farmo helps you decide where and when to sell your crop. It shows mandi prices, compares markets by net value after transport cost, gives a sell-now or wait recommendation, and answers your questions by voice in your own language.

faq.question: How is my net value calculated?
faq.answer: Net value = market price x quantity, minus the transport cost for the distance from your location to that mandi. Farmo shows both figures separately so you can check them.

faq.question: Are these prices live mandi prices?
faq.answer: Check the status tag on every answer. LIVE means the figure came from a live source. DEMO means it is sample market data. Farmo never labels sample data as live.

faq.question: How does the sell or wait advice work?
faq.answer: Farmo compares the net value you would get today against the same calculation at nearby markets and weighs transport cost, price trend and weather risk. The decision uses a fixed rule, so the same inputs always give the same answer.

faq.question: Why does weather affect my decision?
faq.answer: Rain can delay transport, damage unharvested or unsold produce, and push prices. Farmo shows current conditions, rain probability and a short forecast so you can time your sale.

faq.question: Which languages can I use by voice?
faq.answer: English, Hindi, Punjabi, Gujarati, Marathi and Bengali. Your selected app language is sent with every voice request so the answer is spoken back in the same language.

faq.question: Why does it say it has no data for my question?
faq.answer: Farmo only answers from data it has actually fetched. If a price, market or scheme is not available for your crop and location, it says so in your language instead of guessing.

faq.question: Can Farmo tell me if I am eligible for a scheme?
faq.answer: No. Farmo shows what each scheme offers and where to apply, with the official link. Eligibility is decided only by the scheme authority after they verify your records.
